name: Parrish Aviation
category: Program prices, ranges and partial rates
summary: North Texas flight school that gives hourly ranges by aircraft class.
differentiator: Names its own aircraft classes (Cessna 152-class, Sling NGT glass-cockpit, twins) with an hourly range for each, but gives ranges instead of rates and asks for a personalized estimate.
pricing: Older single-engine aircraft $100 to $130 an hour, Sling NGT $160 to $185, CFI $60 to $90.

aircraft.label: Glass-cockpit aircraft such as its Sling NGT

instruction.label: CFI rates, described as typical in North Texas

bestFor: Students who want a rough hourly range by aircraft class in North Texas.
skipIf: You want a posted rate for each aircraft.
watchOut: The CFI range is described as typical for North Texas, not as the school's own rate.
